scoringBreakdown.headlineUnit:

scoringBreakdown.s1Sub: Ranked by shots lost, not by difficulty
scoringBreakdown.s2Sub: Every hole you've played here, sorted
scoringBreakdown.s3Sub: Shots dropped in each third of the round
scoringBreakdown.projectionBody: You average {{avg}} here with {{perRound}} doubles a round. Turning half of them into bogeys is the single biggest gain on this card.
scoringBreakdown.s1Sentence: {{holes}} cost you {{sum}} shots a round - {{share}}% of everything you drop here. Play them for the middle of the green and take your bogey if you need to.
scoringBreakdown.s2SentenceHigh: Bogeys are normal. The {{total}} doubles - {{perRound}} a round - are what actually hurt. Aim for the middle of the green and take two putts: worst case, a bogey.
scoringBreakdown.s2SentenceLow: Doubles are rare for you here. Your shots go in ones, spread across the card - the gains are in putting and approach play.
scoringBreakdown.s3SentenceLate: You fade late: {{worst}} cost {{spread}} shots more than {{best}}. Take on water and something to eat around the 12th, before the drop-off starts.
scoringBreakdown.s3SentenceEarly: You start slowly: {{best}} are {{spread}} shots better than {{worst}}. Hit a few balls and roll some putts before you tee off - your opening holes are doing your warm-up for you.
scoringBreakdown.s3SentenceMiddle: Your middle six cost {{spread}} shots more than {{best}}. That's usually where focus drifts - pick a target on every shot through the turn.
scoringBreakdown.s3SentenceEven: You score evenly across the round - no weak stretch. To go lower, warm up properly before the first tee and keep eating and drinking every few holes so it stays that way.

gameEverywhere.title: Your game, everywhere
gameEverywhere.headlineUnit:
shots over par in an
average round anywhere
gameEverywhere.s1Sub: Your average score over par, by hole type
gameEverywhere.s2Sub: Shots dropped in each third, everywhere you play
gameEverywhere.s1Sentence: Par {{worst}}s are where your round goes - you play them to +{{worstAvg}} a hole while your par {{best}}s run at +{{bestAvg}}. They're {{share}}% of every card you play, so it's the biggest single lever you have.
gameEverywhere.s2SentenceEven: You score evenly across the round, wherever you play - no weak stretch. To go lower, warm up properly before the first tee and keep eating and drinking every few holes so it stays that way.
gameEverywhere.s2SentenceEarly: You start slowly: holes {{best}} are {{spread}} shots better than holes 1-6. Hit a few balls and roll some putts before you tee off - your opening holes are doing your warm-up for you.
gameEverywhere.s2SentenceMiddle: Your middle six cost {{spread}} shots more than holes {{best}}. That's usually where focus drifts - pick a target on every shot through the turn.
gameEverywhere.s2SentenceLate: You fade late: the closing six cost {{spread}} shots more than holes {{best}}. Take on water and something to eat around the 12th, before the drop-off starts.
